Blockticity issues blockchain-secured Certificates of Authenticity (COAs) to verify the origin, handling, and compliance of real-world assets (RWAs) across global supply chains. Powered by our AI engine, CoAi, and integrated with LayerZero interoperability, the Blockticity L1 enables intelligent document validation and composable trust infrastructure for AI-native trade authentication.

The dedicated L1 gives Gunzilla full control over infrastructure, offering instant, gasless transactions, custom game logic, and complete ownership of digital assets, ensuring scalability, security, and interoperability across future titles in its ecosystem.

Hashfire, built on a custom Avalanche L1 using AvaCloud's infrastructure, allows governments and enterprises to embed approval processes, compliance rules and payment instructions directly into smart contracts.

Henesys as an Avalanche L1 gives MapleStory full control over performance, fees, and game logic—enabling seamless on-chain item ownership, player-driven economies, and real-time gameplay—without compromising the speed or scalability players expect from the MapleStory franchise.

Blockchain-based platform transforming the procurement of renewable energy certificates (RECs). Achieves instant settlement of funds and REC transfers with verified serial numbers across 11+ registries. Built to reduce friction and accelerate the energy transition.

Debt capital markets platform on Avalanche L1 for structured finance. Tokenizes loans as NFTs with automated settlements and stablecoins. Digital Liquidity Gateway serves 2,000+ regional banks, connecting them to institutional investors. Built for permissioned access with U.S.-based infrastructure.

Japanese enterprise Loyalty Marketing partnered with blockchain services provider PlayThink to bring Loyalty Marketing's popular loyalty rewards program, 'Ponta', onchain to its 100M users. The Avalanche L1 issues and manage digital loyalty points and NFTs, enabling faster, cheaper, and more transparent customer rewards.
Blockchain-based content platform integrating digital media formats—including games, videos, music, and books—into a Web 3.0 framework.
Purpose-built L1 for AI-native creators. Orange Web3 provides the tools to turn AI-assisted and vibe coded ideas into live products, backed by on-chain rewards and an active user ecosystem.

Web3 sports technology platform with custom Layer 1 blockchain. TheSportsExchange allows fans to buy tradable digital keys tied to real-world sports performance. Features sub-second finality and low-cost micro transactions for high-volume consumer marketplace.

PLAYA3ULL built a gaming-centric blockchain ecosystem: a dedicated Avalanche L1 powering the native token for in-game gas, transactions and deflationary mechanics. It enables players to truly own, trade, and earn from their in-game assets across a growing library of Web3 titles built on the PLAYA3ULL chain.
